newsitem.title: INDIA: BUDGET HIGHLIGHTS - India new tax proposals.
newsitem.headline: BUDGET HIGHLIGHTS - India new tax proposals.

text.p: Following are the highlights of India's tax proposals announced by Finance Minister P. Chidambaram in the annual budget for 1997/98 (April-March) on Friday.
* Tax net widened: Tax on urban rich based on economic criteria
* Voluntary disclosure scheme introduced to bring in black money for productive use
* Senior citizens having an income up to 100,000 rupees excempted from income tax
* Surcharge on corporate tax abolished; rates for domestic and foreign companies reduced
* Export profits exempted from minimum alternate tax (MAT); carry foreward system for MAT introduced
* Peak rates of customs duty reduced to 40 percent from 50 percent
* Customs duty on capital goods and inputs for steel lowered
* Duty reductions for textile industry to increase its competitiveness
* Computer, television telecom equipment, cellphone to be cheaper
